name: Stat
purpose: Present a labeled metric with optional units and comparison text.
useWhen: A read-only value needs a label, unit and contextual comparison.
composition: Compose Root, Label, ValueText and optional HelpText; use FormatNumber or FormatByte inside ValueText.
Use Group for shared size defaults; explicit Root size wins.

rules.statement: Preserve dl/dt/dd grammar; HelpText defaults to dd, not a direct span beneath dl.
Keep calculation and messages application-owned; compose the existing locale and formatting helpers.
Provide comparison wording and choose tone independently of arrow direction.
Load styles.css or core.css plus stat.css and styles for composed components.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a heading solely to size a number.
commonMistakes.correction: Use ValueText and the Stat size recipe.

validation: Check label/value reading order, unit baseline, wrapping, locales, narrow width, RTL, light/dark and forced colors.
